moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean make chart history
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' has made UK chart history by securing a 20th consecutive week at Number 1 on the Official Singles Chart, a new record.

angles.name: Chart Record
angles.copy: 20 WEEKS AT NUMBER ONE! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean just made Official Chart history with 'Rein Me In'. Incredible stuff. What's your favourite track from them?

angles.name: Longest Reign
angles.copy: Breaking records and dominating the airwaves! 'Rein Me In' by Sam Fender & Olivia Dean is still number one for a monumental 20th week. Is it your song of the summer?

moments.title: Carabao Cup Round One kicks off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 EFL season officially begins this weekend with the Carabao Cup First Round, featuring clubs from Championship, League One, and League Two.

angles.name: Cup Football Begins
angles.copy: Football is BACK! The Carabao Cup First Round kicks off this weekend, bringing the first competitive action of the new EFL season. Who are you backing for an early cup run?

angles.name: Welsh Teams in Action
angles.copy: Get ready, Wales! The Carabao Cup First Round starts this weekend, with our local EFL teams battling it out for early season glory. Which Welsh side will go furthest?

moments.title: The Hundred cricket reaches Finals Week
moments.blurb: The Hundred 2026 season is heading into its thrilling climax, with the Eliminator match on August 14 and the Finals Day for both men's and women's competitions on August 16 at Lord's.

angles.name: Cricket Finals Approaching
angles.copy: It's Finals Week for The Hundred! The Eliminator is next Thursday, leading up to the grand finals at Lord's on Sunday, August 16. Who's going to lift the trophy?

angles.name: Lord's Hosts Finals
angles.copy: Lord's is set to host The Hundred Finals Day on August 16! Get ready for a thrilling conclusion to the men's and women's tournaments. Who do you want to see win?

moments.title: Green Man Festival begins
moments.blurb: The Green Man Festival, a beloved independent music and arts event, kicks off in the Brecon Beacons, Wales, from August 20-23, featuring acts like Mogwai, Wilco, Four Tet, and Wolf Alice.

angles.name: Green Man Countdown
angles.copy: The countdown is on for Green Man Festival! From August 20-23, the Brecon Beacons will be buzzing with incredible music and arts. Who are you most excited to see?

angles.name: Welsh Festival Highlight
angles.copy: Wales' iconic Green Man Festival is just around the corner! Four days of independent music, arts, and good vibes in the stunning Brecon Beacons, starting August 20th. Sold out but still the talk of the town!

moments.title: We Out Here Festival returns to Dorset
moments.blurb: Curated by Gilles Peterson, We Out Here Festival brings its celebration of jazz, club culture, soul, and hip hop to Wimborne St Giles, Dorset, from August 20-23, and is already sold out.

angles.name: Dorset Festival Buzz
angles.copy: We Out Here Festival is back in Dorset from August 20-23! Gilles Peterson's genre-hopping celebration of music and culture is sold out and set to be epic. Who's got tickets?

angles.name: Jazz & Club Culture
angles.copy: From jazz to hip hop and house – We Out Here Festival is bringing the best of UK club culture to Dorset next week. Get ready for four days of incredible music!

moments.title: Palace Bowl Presents series continues in London
moments.blurb: The Palace Bowl Presents festival series continues at Crystal Palace Bowl in London until August 16, including the international debut of Roots Picnic on August 8-9.

angles.name: London Gigs This Weekend
angles.copy: London! The Palace Bowl Presents series is in full swing at Crystal Palace, with Roots Picnic making its international debut this weekend (Aug 8-9). Who's heading down?

angles.name: Crystal Palace Music
angles.copy: The iconic Crystal Palace Bowl is hosting a fantastic lineup as part of Palace Bowl Presents, running until August 16. Catch some incredible artists in South London!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Bruce Dickinson
moments.blurb: Bruce Dickinson, the legendary frontman of Iron Maiden, turns 68 today.

angles.name: Metal Legend Birthday
angles.copy: Scream for me, birthday boy! Wishing a huge 68th birthday to the one and only Bruce Dickinson, the iconic voice of Iron Maiden. What's your favourite Maiden track?

angles.name: Maiden Frontman
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday to Bruce Dickinson! The Iron Maiden frontman continues to defy expectations. Raise a glass to a true rock legend.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Jacquie O'Sullivan
moments.blurb: Jacquie O'Sullivan, former member of the iconic 80s pop group Bananarama, celebrates her 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Bananarama Birthday
angles.copy: It's a happy 66th birthday to Jacquie O'Sullivan, who brought her incredible vocals to Bananarama! What's your top Bananarama hit?

angles.name: Pop Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 66th Birthday to Jacquie O'Sullivan, a true 80s pop icon from Bananarama! Bring on the good vibes and classic tunes.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Josh Franceschi
moments.blurb: Josh Franceschi, lead singer of You Me At Six, turns 36 today.

angles.name: You Me At Six Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 36th Birthday to Josh Franceschi, the voice of You Me At Six! What's your go-to track from the band?

angles.name: Rock Star Birthday
angles.copy: Celebrating Josh Franceschi's 36th birthday today! The You Me At Six frontman always delivers. Send him some birthday love!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Jack Black
moments.blurb: Actor, comedian, and half of the rock duo Tenacious D, Jack Black, will celebrate his 57th birthday on August 9th.

angles.name: Rock & Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Get ready to rock! Jack Black turns 57 on Sunday. What's your favourite Tenacious D song or Jack Black movie?

angles.name: The D's Birthday
angles.copy: The legend himself, Jack Black, celebrates his 57th birthday this Sunday! Prepare for some epic rock vibes and legendary laughs. Happy early birthday, JB!

moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 season begins
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season kicks off on Friday, August 21, with reigning champions Arsenal hosting newly-promoted Coventry City.

angles.name: Premier League is Back
angles.copy: The Premier League returns on August 21! Reigning champions Arsenal kick off against Coventry City. Who's your pick for the title this season?

angles.name: Arsenal Kick-off
angles.copy: Arsenal vs Coventry City will open the 2026/27 Premier League season on August 21! Get ready for the return of top-flight football.

moments.title: EFL Championship season starts
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 EFL Championship season begins the weekend of August 14-16, with fixtures released on June 25.

angles.name: Championship Season Returns
angles.copy: Just one week until the EFL Championship season kicks off! Who are you supporting this year? Get ready for all the drama and excitement from August 14-16.

angles.name: Welsh Teams in Championship
angles.copy: The Championship season starts next weekend! Our Welsh teams are ready to fight for promotion. Who's going to make a strong start?

moments.title: Formula 1 Dutch Grand Prix
moments.blurb: The Formula 1 season continues with the Dutch Grand Prix at Zandvoort from August 21-23.

angles.name: F1 is Back
angles.copy: Get ready for some high-speed action! The Formula 1 Dutch Grand Prix roars into Zandvoort next weekend, August 21-23. Who's taking the win?

angles.name: Zandvoort Race
angles.copy: The F1 circus heads to Zandvoort for the Dutch Grand Prix next week! Who are you backing on race day, Sunday August 23?

moments.title: Mixed UK August Weather Ahead
moments.blurb: The UK is set for a mixed start to August, with an increased chance of rain in northwestern areas, but generally average to above-average temperatures, potentially very warm or hot in the south by mid-next week.

angles.name: August Weather Outlook
angles.copy: August is bringing a mixed bag of weather! More rain for the northwest, but warmer spells are on the way for the south next week. What's your ideal August forecast?

angles.name: Warm Spells
angles.copy: Keep an eye on the forecast! Temperatures are set to rise in southern parts of the UK by mid-next week, with some very warm or hot weather possible. Perfect for those last summer plans!
